about: The crypt's Bishop's tomb (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB13): a fight room, a floating slab of the crypt's flagstones; its landmark the bishop's great tomb in the middle, two sarcophagi laid end to end under the shaft of light, a candle at each corner, four pillars round it. Its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall), held straight under its sockets (north, east, south) by pins. tools/ground_shape.py draws arena_06_ground.tscn and its art from this.
